The '''2017–18 Maryland Terrapins men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Maryland, College Park]] in the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by seventh-year head coach [[Mark Turgeon]] and played their home games at [[Xfinity Center (College Park, Maryland)|Xfinity Center]] in [[College Park, Maryland]], as members of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. They finished the season 19–13, 8–10 in [[2017–18 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in eighth place. They lost in the second round of the [[2018 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]] to [[2017–18 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Wisconsin]]. They were invited to the [[College Basketball Invitational]], but declined, marking their absence in a postseason tournament for the first time since [[2013–14 Maryland Terrapins men's basketball team|2014]].

==Previous season==
The [[2016–17 Maryland Terrapins men's basketball team|Terrapins]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 24–9, 12–6 in [[2016–17 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in a tie for second place. As the No. 3 seed in the [[2017 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], they lost to [[2016–17 Northwestern Wildcats men's basketball team|Northwestern]] in the quarterfinals.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.insidenu.com/2017/3/10/14890944/northwestern-maryland-final-score-big-ten-tournament-2017-chris-collins-melo-trimble-bryant-mcintosh|title=RAPID REACTION: Northwestern beats Maryland 72–64 to advance to semifinals|work=Inside NU|access-date=2017-07-28}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400945802|title=Northwestern vs. Maryland – Game Recap – March 10, 2017 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-07-28}}</ref> They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. As a No. 6 seed in the West region, they lost in the first round to [[2016–17 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/colleges/maryland-basketball-fizzles-out-in-ncaa-tournament-loss-to-xavier/2017/03/16/cd547f5c-0a82-11e7-a15f-a58d4a988474_story.html|title=Maryland basketball fizzles out in NCAA tournament loss to Xavier|website=Washington Post|access-date=2017-07-28}}</ref>

== Schedule and results ==
The [[2018 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|2018 Big Ten tournament]] will be held at [[Madison Square Garden]] in [[New York City]].<ref name=":4">{{Cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2014/12/09/big-ten-tournament-at-msg-in-2018/20156595/|title=Big Ten tournament at MSG in 2018|work=USA TODAY|access-date=2017-04-14|language=en}}</ref> Due to the [[Big East Conference|Big East]]'s use of that venue for their conference tournament, the Big Ten tournament will take place one week earlier than usual, ending the week before Selection Sunday.<ref name=":5">{{Cite news|url=http://www.freep.com/story/sports/college/michigan-state/spartans/2014/12/09/big-ten-tournament-new-york/20122853/|title=Izzo concerned about '18 Big Ten tournament in New York|work=Detroit Free Press|access-date=2017-04-14|language=en}}</ref> This could result in teams having nearly two weeks off before the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]].<ref name=":5" /> As a result, it is anticipated that the Big Ten regular season will begin in mid-December.<ref name=":4" /> Coaches have requested that no Big Ten game be scheduled between Christmas and New Year's Day, accordingly each team will play two conference games in early December before finishing non-conference play.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://247sports.com/college/michigan-state/article/michigan-state-basketballs-2017-18-schedule-what-we-know-52728111/|title=Michigan State basketball's 2017–18 schedule: What we know|work=SpartanTailgate|access-date=2017-07-28}}</ref>
